allowlisted_contexts.reason: The execution plan may describe risk categories and scanner implementation rules, but must not contain real host paths or raw private artifact paths.
The high-level design may describe risk categories, but must not contain real host paths or raw private artifact paths.

public_evidence_policy: Public inventory files may contain labels, commit hashes, relative repository paths, sha256 digests, module names, and runtime-private opaque refs. They must not contain host absolute paths or raw private evidence paths.
stage16f_0_json_policy: Formal public evidence JSON files must not use allowlisted risk words directly; use categories and opaque refs instead.
